title: Reasoning map: reasoning profile
description: What kind of inference each arrow is, what it rests on, and what would refute each claim. Adds fields to core; requires none.

for.description: Evidence for the claim. One item per piece of evidence.

falsifier.description: What would change my mind: the observation that would show the claim is wrong.

measure.description: For a claim true by construction (a definition or an identity), which cannot be wrong, only big or small: what to measure instead.

weight.description: Free text: how much this drives the outcome.

confidence.description: Free text on a node. Arrows use the graded field in the grades profile.

inference.description: deductive: follows from the premises in 'given'. inductive: generalised from cases. abductive: the best explanation of what is observed. causal: an asserted mechanism with no further support given.

given.description: The premises of a deductive link. A deduction is only as good as these.

combines.description: How this arrow combines with the other arrows into the same box.

note.description: Why the link holds, or why it is weaker than it looks.
